$schema: Reachability hand sample (spec §20 Reachability labels): about 5 observed true positives per library, each hand-labeled unconditional or conditional by the §7 rules, judged from the install entry along the chain, with a code citation. It settles what the base run's observation leaves open (not guarded-native-absence). Libraries whose protected positives the base run never observes (es6-promise, promise-polyfill, whatwg-fetch) have none. Most SDK writes sit behind an init configuration test, so the sample is mostly conditional; core-js and single-spa install at load with no guard that matters.
